programs.title: Mister Maker Around The World
programs.desc: In South Africa Mini Makers create a huge sand castle on a beach; in Australia find out if he can make a cute cup creature in under a minute; and in Brazil discover how a plant spray can make a fabulous rain forest picture.

programs.desc: Count along to 'One, Two, Three, Four, Five', and join the fun! Paloma the Mermaid is visiting today but Lucia, Simon, and Lachy have lost their Wiggle. Can Tsehay help them find it before she arrives?

programs.desc: Rangers Zindzi and Takaya explore all the fascinating plants you find in the rainforest! They create a rainforest terrarium, make a yummy avocado snack, and find out how different rainforest plants live and grow together!
